defects.summary: The main QA workflow runs its full matrix for documentation-only changes and runs pytest on one process.

features.name: Parallel-safety and flake resistance of the suite
verified_by: reproduced here: `pytest -n 1` on test_paths_outside_allowed_roots_are_refused fails with "DID NOT RAISE PathGuardError" at tests/test_research_qualification_cli.py:70; the same selection passes without -n (2 passed in 0.53 s)
GitHub Actions run 42605088788 (2026-11-09, push on main@882d1ca0, conclusion success) (serial suite and qt-gate 20x/5x green)
static scan: 0 raw os.chdir, 0 fixed ports (all binds use port 0), 90 time.sleep lines
remaining: Root cause of the known xdist failure (K-D02): the test climbs exactly four ".." from tmp_path. Serial: /tmp/pytest-of-U/pytest-N/test_x0 -> four levels up is "/" -> /etc/passwd is outside the allowed roots -> PathGuardError. Under xdist the base temp gains one level (/tmp/pytest-of-U/pytest-N/popen-gwK/test_x0) -> four levels up is /tmp -> /tmp/etc/passwd is inside tempfile.gettempdir(), an allowed root (tools/research_qualification/pathguard.py:15) -> no error. No shared state, cwd or environment variable is involved; it fails with a single worker too.

Second fragility in the same test: line 69 needs tmp_path to be under the system temp directory or the cwd; with --basetemp outside both (the unmerged CI-speed branch uses --basetemp "${{ runner.temp }}/pt") PG.confine(f) raises (derived from pathguard.py:14-28, not run).

tests/test_unified_cor_pipeline.py:52,61 compares listings of the shared system temp directory before and after; another worker creating pt-unified-* there breaks it (tests/test_unified_pipeline.py:322-328 already uses a private temp root for the same reason).

14 @given tests in 8 files run with Hypothesis defaults (200 ms deadline, random seed): tests/test_evalcore_stats.py (5), test_enrichment_wil.py (2), test_enrichment_core.py (2), test_unified_irx_cfg.py, test_unified_pair_text.py, test_unified_irx_pe.py, test_evalcore_scoring.py, test_enrichment_hardening.py. No shared profile exists.

Tight wall-clock budgets that parallel load can break: tests/test_cli_registry.py:271 (<= 0.125 s), tests/test_gui_host_seam.py:128 (< 0.5 s), tests/test_kev_parse.py:487 (< 1.0 s), tests/test_slow_drip_deadlines.py:118,125, tests/test_pe_api_delta.py:245 (< 2 s).

No per-test timeout and no faulthandler_timeout; a hung test consumes the 120-minute job limit (tests/conftest.py:25-26 documents one two-hour hang). The modal-dialog watchdog covers only QMessageBox.exec.
No --strict-markers and no xfail_strict in pyproject.toml (only one custom marker is registered and used, so adoption is safe).
Import-time process state: 114 sys.path.insert calls and 16 sys.modules assignments in tests (TST-11 open); order-dependence from these was not observed.

Latent only: tests/test_research_qualification_adapters.py:210 sets TMPDIR; if that were the first tempfile.gettempdir() call in a process the cached value would outlive the test. Not reproduced (the cache was already filled in the xdist worker).

defects.summary: test_paths_outside_allowed_roots_are_refused hard-codes the depth of tmp_path and assumes tmp_path lies under the system temp directory.
defects.failure_scenario: Any pytest-xdist run (even -n 1), or a deeper TMPDIR/--basetemp: tmp_path/../../../../etc/passwd resolves to /tmp/etc/passwd, inside the temp root, so confine() returns and pytest.raises fails.
defects.proposed_fix: Build the traversal from the real depth (tmp_path.joinpath(*['..'] * len(tmp_path.parts), 'etc', 'passwd')) and make the positive case independent of the temp root (monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path) or RQ_ALLOWED_DIRS=tmp_path); assert the escape target is outside every allowed root before calling confine.
defects.regression_test: Run the test serially, with -n 2, and with --basetemp under a directory that is neither cwd nor the system temp; all three must pass.

defects.summary: A unified pipeline test asserts that the shared system temp directory listing is unchanged across the test.
defects.failure_scenario: Under xdist a second worker runs any test that creates a pt-unified-* scratch directory between the two listings; the set comparison fails although the code under test cleaned up correctly.
defects.proposed_fix: Give the test a private temp root (monkeypatch.setattr(tempfile, 'tempdir', str(tmp_path_factory.mktemp('tmproot')))), as tests/test_unified_pipeline.py:322-328 does.
defects.regression_test: Run tests/test_unified_cor_pipeline.py together with tests/test_unified_pipeline.py under -n 4 --dist load repeatedly; no failure.

defects.summary: Fourteen property tests rely on the default Hypothesis deadline and a random seed.
defects.evidence: tests/test_evalcore_stats.py, tests/test_enrichment_wil.py, tests/test_enrichment_core.py, tests/test_unified_irx_cfg.py, tests/test_unified_pair_text.py, tests/test_unified_irx_pe.py, tests/test_evalcore_scoring.py, tests/test_enrichment_hardening.py (no settings/deadline in any of them); tests/conftest.py (no profile)

defects.proposed_fix: Register and load one profile in tests/conftest.py (deadline=None; print_blob=True; derandomize when CI is set) so tests without explicit settings inherit it.
defects.regression_test: tests/test_hypothesis_profile.py: assert hypothesis.settings.default.deadline is None after conftest import.

defects.proposed_fix: Use best-of-N timing or CPU time (time.process_time) for pure-CPU budgets, as tests/test_codetext_tokens.py does.

known_flake.fix: Derive the number of ".." from len(tmp_path.parts) and make the positive case use RQ_ALLOWED_DIRS or chdir (K-T01).
